newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean president names new finance minister - TV.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean president names new finance minister - TV.

text.p: South Korean president Kim Young-sam on Wednesday appointed a new finance minister, Kang Kyong-shik, a ruling New Korea Party lawmaker with extensive experience in government, Yonhap Television News reported.
An official at the presidential Blue House confirmed the report. He said Kang would replace Han Seung-soo, who also served as deputy prime minister.
The president also appointed Lim Chang-yuel to take over from Ahn Kwang-koo as trade minister.
A total of seven ministerial portfolios changed hands in a reshuffle designed to help restore the president's political credibility badly damaged by a loans scandal involving bankrupt Hanbo Steel Co.
Other changes included the ministers for Home Affairs, Justice, Science and Technology, Culture and Sports, Construction and Transportation.
